title: Grit Front
body: A wall of grit rolls off the day side. The solar arrays will be half-blind for a few turns.

title: Vent Surge
body: The ground rumbles and the vents run hot. The vent taps are giving more heat than they were rated for.

title: Seal Failure
body: A pressure seal gave out overnight. The crew has shut the building down for repairs.

title: Shifting Ice
body: An icequake split a ridge and exposed loose ore near the landing pad. A work crew hauls it in.

title: The Auditor
body: A Company auditor arrives on the supply lander and asks to see every account.

title: Stowaways
body: Four people climb out of a cargo pod, cold and frightened. They were not on any manifest.

choices.label: Hand them to the Company (+60 marks, morale -6)

title: A Day Off
body: The work crews ask for one turn off. They have not stopped since landing.

choices.label: Grant it (no work next turn, morale +8)

title: Premium Buyer
body: An orbital buyer offers well over the Company price for an immediate alloy shipment.

title: A Quiet Offer
body: A Company clerk offers to lose some paperwork in exchange for your colony's ore.

title: Icequake
body: The ice shelf shifts with a sound like a gunshot. Buildings near the epicentre are shaken off their footings.
